Electrical Permit Fees

Effective 10/01/00

Residential
New Houses, Condos, Town Houses and Apartments$50 plus $30 for each 100 amPS of service (secondary side of transformer) $80 for 100 amPS, $110 for 200 amPS etc.
Temporary Service$25 per 100 amPS
Service Change$25 per 100 amPS
Swimming Pools (above ground)$25
Swimming Pools
(in ground)		$40
Additions, Remodels$50
$25
Smoke Detectors$25
$25
$25
Security and Fire Alarm systems$25
Solar Installation$50
Solar Energy Storage Systems (ESS)$50
Commercial
New$50 per 100 amPS (secondary side of transformer) plus $15 per 1,000 square feet on new construction
Temporary Service$30 per 100 amPS (secondary side of transformer)
Security and Fire Alarm Systems$5 per 1,000 square feet
Minimum Fee$50
Existing Construction, Remodel, and Tenant Fix-ups
Service Change$40 per 100 amPS (secondary side of transformers)
Panels Install or Change(each panel)$25
1-60 Terminations(devices)$50
61-100 Outlets$70
Over 100(or part there of)$15 per additional hundred
Minimum Fee for Repairs$50
Signs(each)$50
Retrofit of Ballast(per building)$50
Outlets = Outlets, Lights, Switches, Fire Alarm, Security Systems, Video Systems for Security, Data Systems, Phone Systems
Maintenance Permits

Cover only the following:

  • All repairs
  • New installations up to five 125 VOLT DEVICES (i.e. plugs, lights, switches)
  • Routine ballast repair
  • One for one replacement of equipment

Maintenance permits require that the electrician call for at least four inspections per year / $400.00

Additional Permits
City of Waltham BuildingsPermit required, no fee
Carnival PermitsCarnival cannot open without electrical inspector's approval // $50
Generator Installations$50 per 100 amps secondary side of service

View Electrical Permit Application // Pay Permit Fees Online

Inspections Required during non-business hours

  • $200 each inspection

Reinspection Fee

  • Applies to all permits: $50 for the first; $100 for all subsequent inspections for the same violation

We accept checks, money orders, cash only accepted with exact change Credit cards accepted for online payments. If you have any questions with regard to an application, please contact us at 781-314-3175.
